fields.name: Name
fields.label: Name of the LLM configuration
fields.description: Single provider can be used with multiple configurations, with different names

fields.name: ApiKey
fields.label: API Key
fields.description: The API key or authentication token required to access the LLM provider's services. Can be a dummy string for local LLMs

fields.name: HttpEndPoint
fields.label: HTTP Endpoint
fields.description: The base URL or endpoint for the LLM provider's API. Must be specified for Local AI

fields.name: Models
fields.label: Models
fields.description: List of models for the LLM provider that can be used. Each model should be specified by its name or identifier as recognized by the provider.
